notes: Original gravimetric H2 isotherms (Rubotherm magnetic suspension balance) at 77 K and 298 K up to 15 MPa on six activated carbons (AT 470335, AT 470344, AT 100004, AC1, AC2, AC3), plus zeolites, an aerogel and MOFs. Fig. 2a (77 K) and Fig. 4 (298 K, AT 470335) are the measured carbon isotherms; AT 470335 maximum ca. 3.6 wt% at 2-5 MPa (Section 3). MOF-177, MOF-200, MOF-205, MOF-210 and UMCM-2 are literature data included for comparison only; the rest are measured here. ABET from N2 at 77 K is on the same samples. The article also contains an assessment framework, but it reports its own measurements, so not a review. record.json is_retracted is false; no retraction notice and no statement that the H2 values were published before. No supplementary files in input (main only).
